# Signet Artists

> Signet Artists delivers live entertainment for private events in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas. We provide a variety of genres and configurations - effortlessly.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, BOULDER, and the mountain corridor. No prices are published. What the pricing page carries is what live music costs in this market, each figure with the source it came from, and Signet prices a specific night when the date is sent.

## Credits

Trusted and booked by Amazon, NBCUniversal, Charles Schwab, Kroger, Denver Art Museum, Sheraton, Hyatt, Washington Nationals, Casa Bonita and Monarch Casino Resort Spa Black Hawk. Also Live Nation, Valley Country Club and the National Cherry Blossom Festival, and the stages at Dazzle, the Bluebird Theater, Cervantes, the 9:30 Club and many, many more.

## Acts

All acts and configurations are subject to availability.

- Tejas Singh (Singer-songwriter covers, fronted by Tejas Singh): Authentic and intimate with a specialty in building familiar songs from the ground up with his amazing ear and looping tech, Tejas brings a wide variety of fan favorite songs and is also available to play his original, singer-songwriter material to your event. Configurations: Duo to quartet. https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/
- Jazz Duo (Jazz standards, Upright bass and guitar): Class it up with jazz standards on upright bass and guitar, bring immediate sophistication to any cocktail hour or special event. The Signet Jazz duo specializes in music for when guests arrive, sip cocktails or enjoy dinner. This act is the perfect musical glue that holds the night together effortlessly. The volume and genre sit perfectly under riveting conversations. Configurations: Duo to trio. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/
- Dirty Flamenco (Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers): Brilliant, guitar-based flamenco musical act and one of the only in Colorado available for private events. Dirty flamenco plays real palos, and rhumba both authentically and with a soulful twist. Their polish as a working group is matched by their extensive standing repertoire. Configurations: Trio, larger by request. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/
- Funk Band (Funk and soul, Guitar, bass and drums, with a horn or keys at quartet size): Instrumental funk and soul covers for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. It books as a trio of guitar, bass and drums, or as a quartet with a horn or keys when the floor wants more. Configurations: Trio to quartet. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/funk-band/
- DJ (Open format, Decks, and a PA sized to the venue): Book a DJ on their own or to carry a late night set after the band wraps their set. All run by the same team, with the same contract. A solid DJ gets people moving and is the most common single booking of the corporate season. Configurations: solo to duo. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/
- Tony Medina (Blues, rock and roots, fronted by Tony Medina): A smoky voice and a guitar played with a funk guitarist's right hand. Tony Medina plays the blues and the rock and roll that came out of it, Freddie King and B.B. King through The Cars and Prince, with a book of his own songs threaded through. He plays solo for welcome drinks and dinner, and up to a four piece when the night wants a dance floor. Configurations: Solo to quartet. https://signetartists.com/artists/tony-medina/
- Last Consulate (Instrumental downtempo, Upright bass, guitar and electronics, one musician): One player, upright bass and guitar out front, over downtempo electronics with slow hip-hop drums, worn keys and delayed guitar. Jazz improvisation on top, at conversation volume. Arrival, cocktails and dinner, on original material that sounds closer to an early-2000s downtempo record than to a jazz set. Configurations: Solo. https://signetartists.com/artists/last-consulate/
- Live Band Karaoke (Party covers, the 80s and 90s onward, Voice and guitar, keys, bass, drums, and a host working the mic): A party band that plays the 80s and 90s hits on its own, then hands the mic to anyone in the crowd who wants a song. Nobody has to sing for the night to work, and the band is ready the moment somebody does. Configurations: Quartet to six piece. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/live-band-karaoke/
- Yacht Rock Band (Yacht rock, Three voices, keys, guitar, bass, drums and saxophone): Doobie Brothers, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto and Christopher Cross, sung in harmony with the saxophone out front. It's the summer party band, and the late set a whole crowd knows the words to. Configurations: Quartet to six piece. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/yacht-rock/
- Americana Band (Americana and the Colorado songbook, Voice and acoustic guitar, fiddle or mandolin, upright bass, drums): This is the band for a Colorado evening with a crowd that flew in for it. It plays Grateful Dead, Tom Petty and Neil Young beside Nathaniel Rateliff and Gregory Alan Isakov, on acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass and drums, for a welcome reception, a ranch dinner or a summer picnic. Configurations: Trio to quartet. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/americana-band/

Your people lie down in low light for seventy-five minutes with nothing to do and nothing to say, with live instruments played over composed music and bass deep enough to feel in your chest, and Firstwater opens and closes the session with ceremony. Firstwater brings it to your venue or holds it in a partner space in Denver, and it books for wellness weeks, team building days, retreats and transition days. Configurations: One facilitator, seventy-five minutes. https://signetartists.com/artists/firstwater/

## Pricing

Signet Artists publishes no price list, no starting prices and no hourly figures. Actual prices vary by date, size, hours and location. https://signetartists.com/pricing/ sets out what live music costs in this market, with each figure attributed to the public source it came from, so a reader can set a budget before writing to Signet. To get the number for a specific night, send the date: https://signetartists.com/contact/

Travel beyond the Denver metro, a night's lodging past the passes, holiday weekends and New Year's Eve are quoted as their own lines rather than folded into a headline figure.
